tests.name: the emitter's behavioural update: completion, replay and share rates from the plays, velocity, and exposure growing by every play on each update (as the reference's does)

tests.name: clusters (threshold 0.80) over the reference's own test vectors plus three more: tight groups split the same whatever the seed order, and ids go by the first track's id

steps.expect: count(c in TrackCluster where c.cluster == max(d.cluster in TrackCluster where d.track == "dark1")) == 3
max(c.cluster in TrackCluster where c.track == "dark2") == max(c.cluster in TrackCluster where c.track == "dark1")
max(c.cluster in TrackCluster where c.track == "dark3") == max(c.cluster in TrackCluster where c.track == "dark1")
count(c in TrackCluster where c.cluster == max(d.cluster in TrackCluster where d.track == "chill")) == 2
max(c.cluster in TrackCluster where c.track == "chill2") == max(c.cluster in TrackCluster where c.track == "chill")
count(c in TrackCluster where c.cluster == max(d.cluster in TrackCluster where d.track == "odd")) == 1
